facts.text: The resort is on Koh Yao Noi in Phang Nga Bay, 45 minutes from Phuket.
facts.excerpt: Just 45 minutes from Phuket, this Six Senses island resort in Thailand is as close to nature’s luxury as you can be.

facts.text: Limestone pinnacles rising from Phang Nga Bay form the backdrop of the resort.
facts.excerpt: The iconic limestone pinnacles rising from the waters of Phang Nga Bay create a surreal backdrop for Six Senses Yao Noi

facts.text: The resort's surroundings recall the Bond movie setting, with limestone pinnacles rising from the bay.
facts.excerpt: You’ve seen the Bond movie, now experience the real thing. The surreal backdrop to your Thailand island resort holiday includes fantastical limestone pinnacles rising from the bay

facts.text: Villas are enveloped in tropical greenery and each has a private swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: Villas are enveloped in tropical greenery and complete with a private swimming pool for your ultimate Koh Yao Noi hotel hideaway.

facts.text: A GEM (Guest Experience Maker) arranges guests' activities.
facts.excerpt: your GEM (Guest Experience Maker) is on hand to make every activity (or inactivity) a reality

facts.text: The Ocean Retreat offers comfort, privacy and space for groups.
facts.excerpt: Room for all of you: comfort, privacy and space at The Ocean Retreat

facts.text: The Hilltop restaurant offers views with every menu.
facts.excerpt: Head up to The Hilltop for mesmerizing views with every menu

facts.text: The Living Room serves authentic Thai cuisine by the beach.
facts.excerpt: Relax and savor authentic Thai cuisine by the beach at the Living Room

facts.text: Six Senses Spa offers wellness and healing treatments.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in pioneering wellness and healing treatments at Six Senses Spa

facts.text: Children can join the Junior Eco Warrior Program.
facts.excerpt: Grow With Six Senses with the Junior Eco Warrior Program

facts.text: Hornbills live on the island, and guests can join initiatives to preserve and regenerate its tropical flora and fauna.
facts.excerpt: You’ll meet our special guests such as the hornbills and all their feathered friends. Why not join the initiatives we have in place to preserve and re-generate the island’s tropical flora and fauna?
